title: Longer EnderPearl Cooldown
description: Increase the Ender Pearl use cooldown for more balanced gameplay
body:
This datapack increases the cooldown time between Ender Pearl uses, making teleportation more balanced and strategic.

Normally, players can spam Ender Pearls to move quickly or escape danger, which can make PvP and survival challenges too easy. With this datapack, players must wait longer before throwing another Ender Pearl — encouraging smarter gameplay and fairer combat

**Features**:

- Extends the Ender Pearl cooldown duration to 20 seconds.

- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

- Lightweight and compatible with other datapacks.
